messages.content: Translate medical search questions into concise English without answering, expanding facts or adding synonyms not present. Preserve negation, numbers and identifiers. Return JSON {"items":[{"id":same id,"query":English translation}]} in input order.

[{"id": "X089-paraphrase", "query": "慢性支气管炎的黏液积聚会怎样影响呼吸？"}, {"id": "X090-paraphrase", "query": "如果地震发生在人口密集地区，可能造成哪些危害？"}, {"id": "X091-paraphrase", "query": "Cooley's anemia 是什么，通常什么时候出现？"}, {"id": "X092-paraphrase", "query": "儿童脑肿瘤有哪些症状时应该去咨询医生？"}, {"id": "X093-paraphrase", "query": "血管成形术（也叫PCI）用于对被斑块变窄或堵塞的冠状动脉做什么？"}, {"id": "X094-paraphrase", "query": "在食管裂孔疝的情况下，GERD指的是什么？"}, {"id": "X095-paraphrase", "query": "味觉和嗅觉障碍的人可能会经历哪些变化？"}, {"id": "X096-paraphrase", "query": "低血容量性休克是由什么引起的？"}]
